name: Ren Kiryu
profile: The untouchable beauty every guy admires. Cool and distant at first glance, but...

card.text: Gifted with looks and smarts, this girl's out of most guys' league. Upon first impression, she seems distant and cold, but is she really...? Will you be the one to thaw her heart?
card._confirmed: Same text, word for word, on the 'Choose Your Girl' profile of Honey I'm Home! (the predecessor's English edition; Mega Assets pack, research/mega_assets/Random/)

name: Aki Momohara
profile: A hugely popular idol with a secret that slowly comes to light.

card.quote: This is just for the sake of my role!
card.text: A real pop idol! This girl's about to turn your life upside down! The more you get to know each other, the clearer it becomes that she's holding a secret. Will you ever know her true feelings?
card._confirmed: Same text, word for word, on the 'Choose Your Girl' profile of Honey I'm Home! (the predecessor's English edition; Mega Assets pack, research/mega_assets/Random/)

name: Mitsuka Ibuki
quote: If you'd like, shall we walk home together?
quote_ja: よかったら、一緒に帰りませんか？
profile: The youngest resident but the most dependable one. Very shy.

card.quote: Do you... want to help me?
card.text: She might be the youngest, but she has a good head on her shoulders! She's so shy... What could be her motivation for living in a share-house? As you two share your lives together, the distance between you gradually disappears...
card._confirmed: Same text, word for word, on the 'Choose Your Girl' profile of Honey I'm Home! (the predecessor's English edition; Mega Assets pack, research/mega_assets/Random/)

name: Aoi Mizusawa
quote_ja: あははっ。どう？元気出た？
profile: Your club senpai and best friend, the mood-maker who brought you to the share house.

card.text: She's always the life of the party and knows how to cheer you up. You've been close friends since you were kids, but can you turn your friendship into something more...?
card._confirmed: Same text, word for word, on the 'Choose Your Girl' profile of Honey I'm Home! (the predecessor's English edition; Mega Assets pack, research/mega_assets/Random/)

name: Sayaka Shimono
quote_ja: あはは、照れちゃって。可愛い～
profile: The No.1 hostess, who has men wrapped around her finger.

card.quote: You're so cute when you're shy!
card.text: Using her beauty and her charms, she manipulates men like puppets! What sort of life awaits for you if you fall for her tricks?
card._confirmed: Same text, word for word, on the 'Choose Your Girl' profile of Honey I'm Home! (the predecessor's English edition; Mega Assets pack, research/mega_assets/Random/)

name: Misaki Fujinaga
quote_ja: あなたったら、イヤラシイんだから
profile: A grown-up career woman and the kind landlady of the share house.

card.quote: Honestly, all you ever think about is naughty stuff...
card.text: A successful career woman with grown-up charm!! As our landlady, she always looks after us as gently as a big sister. Why she started the share-house will be revealed!! And how will your romance end...!?
card._source: Traditional Chinese edition's Character card (166cm/47kg/B86/W59/H87; quote 「真是、滿腦都是想歪歪的…」; text 「充滿大人成熟魅力的事業女強人！！身為房東的她，總是如姊姊般溫柔的對待我們。開始合租房子的動機也將會揭密！！然後，戀愛的結局會是！？」), a player's screenshot from 2017-12-15 (research/hunt3/drive/06_misaki). English is my translation; units converted like the other cards (inches rounded down, lbs rounded).
